title: Only 21 Of 1,652 Pentagon UFO Reports Stayed Unexplained
hook: The Pentagon logged 1,652 UFO reports, but only 21 stayed unexplained.
closing: More reports made the mystery look bigger than the unresolved evidence.
question: What should the Pentagon investigate next?

segments.say: Pentagon UFO reports rose from 281 to 757, nearly tripling.
FAA controllers filed 392 reports versus 365 from every other source.
Only 21 of 1,652 Pentagon UFO reports remained flagged as unexplained.
